name: levels/level-1-provider-url-ipv4-number
description: Negative fixture: the DOMAIN_VERIFIED AgentCard whose provider.url is https://0x7f.0.0.1, while the domain attestation, the agentId and the DNS TXT record name all spell the host the same way, 0x7f.0.0.1. A host whose last label is a number is an IPv4 address, and the WHATWG URL parser reports it in dotted-decimal form: the provider domain is 127.0.0.1. A conforming verifier MUST reject: no binding names 127.0.0.1. A verifier that compares the host as written accepts, and so treats two spellings of one address as two domains.
